say:3:1029792701:1.text: I read the reports. I didn't think you'd move this fast!
say:3:1029792701:1.source_cn: 我看过了报告，没想到你们进度有这么快！

say:4:1029792702:1.text: With support from the Mithril Consortium, has there been any trouble on the logistics side?
say:4:1029792702:1.source_cn: 这次有秘银商会支持，整体运营上有什么困难吗？

say:5:1029792703:1.text: Production and sales are fine. As for the orders, the folks in Brimstone Village know what they're doing.
say:5:1029792703:1.source_cn: 生产和销售那些没问题，做订单嘛，深岩村的人干这个比我熟。

say:6:1029792704:1.text: The real issue is that this place isn't built for tourism.
say:6:1029792704:1.source_cn: 只不过和别的地方比，这里不太适合迎接游客。

say:7:1029792705:1.text: It's just grass, rocks, some workshops, the village, and the mines. Everyone's busy just handling orders.
say:7:1029792705:1.source_cn: 看来看去，除了那些草啊石头啊，就只有工坊、村子和矿洞，...

say:8:1029792706:1.text: Even if tourists are curious, there's not much for them to see.
say:8:1029792706:1.source_cn: 就算游客有兴趣参观，也没地方给他们看啊。

say:9:1029792707:1.text: True. That hands-on weapon workshop we tried before didn't really work for visitors.
say:9:1029792707:1.source_cn: 确实……之前那种亲手尝试生产武器的工坊体验，好像也没法...

say:10:1029792708:1.text: And there's no real inn for guests to stay at either.
say:10:1029792708:1.source_cn: 最重要的是，村子里好像也没有适合招待客人的旅店啊。

say:11:1029792709:1.text: Maybe it's time Brimstone Village started thinking about a transformation, if it wants to grow...
say:11:1029792709:1.source_cn: 看起来深岩村要想发展，还得考虑考虑转型……
